Bloomberg PL C close 4.30/4.92/5.52; Erste EUR/PLN close 4.2334

policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 15 Apr close (1x4 3.86, 3x6 3.93, 6x9 4.03, 9x12 4.13 vs WIBOR 3M 3.84) price roughly 30bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 9 Apr; Glapiński sees no near-term change either way - hikes only in a 'black scenario' of renewed war, a question mark over cuts. Kotecki (14 Apr): unchanged at least until the July projection; Janczyk: hikes only if CPI stays above 3.75% for three months. March CPI 3.0% (final, 15 Apr; flash 31 Mar, 3.3% expected); core 2.5% in February. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 30 Apr (13 Apr).
policy.risk_text: Two-sided: Hormuz headlines swing oil by up to 10% a day; the MPC holds at least until July (Kotecki), so the front end is anchored near WIBOR while 5-10Y follows Bunds and oil. Supply: April sales of PLN 15-39bn.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar); the NBP forecaster survey (1 Apr) has 2026 CPI at 2.9%; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%. The next projection comes in July.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.2% of GDP (GUS preliminary, 1 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; S&P (2-6 Apr) sees a 2026 deficit of 7.0% of GDP (8.0% in an oil-shock case); budget deficit after March PLN 69.6bn (25.6% of the limit); fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) to 30 Apr.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~41% (end-Q1) financed; USD 6bn of 5Y/10Y/30Y priced on 7 Apr (UST +65/+105/+130bp); budget accounts PLN 169.5bn at end-March. No rating action in April; S&P reviews Poland on 8 May (A-, stable); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar and held on 9 Apr; March CPI 3.0% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 15 Apr: MoF sold PLN 10.7bn (offer 6-12bn, demand 12.1bn, cover 1.13) plus 0.35bn additional - PS0731 5.3bn at 5.02%, DS1035 2.5bn at 5.51%, WS0428 1.3bn at 4.27%; final March CPI confirmed at 3.0% (1.1% m/m); IMF Fiscal Monitor: 2026 deficit 6.7% of GDP; EUR/PLN 4.23, back near its pre-war level. Abroad: hopes of a truce extension (it expires 22 Apr) kept Brent near $95 as the US blockade took full effect; Bund 10Y ~3.04%, at least two ECB and two BoE hikes priced; the Fed is seen on hold all year (Beige Book: the war is a major uncertainty).

calendar.plan_text: MoF April plan (31 Mar): sale auctions on 15 Apr (PLN 4-12bn; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1035, NZ0936), 23 Apr (6-14bn) and 28 Apr (5-13bn; new 10Y DS0436 replaces DS1035 from 23 Apr); no switch; a 50-week T-bill on 10 Apr (3-6bn). Q2 plan: 7-8 sales for PLN 50-90bn and 1-2 switches. 2026 needs ~41% financed at end-Q1. 7 Apr: USD 6bn issue (5Y 4.645%, 10Y 5.405%, 30Y 6.233%). 10 Apr T-bill: PLN 3.0bn at 3.95% (demand 3.6bn) plus 0.39bn. 15 Apr sale: PLN 10.71bn vs 12.13bn demand (cover 1.13) plus 0.35bn; PS0731 5.023%, DS1035 5.514%, WS0428 4.271%.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it. April is back to regular supply: remaining sales 23 Apr, 28 Apr. Next MPC 5-6 May: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker. Covers so far: 1.13 (15 Apr) vs 1.17 on 25 Mar.

facts.core_text: Regime: fragile truce with a US blockade of Iranian ports - oil swinging between $90 and $105; the NBP held at 3.75% on 9 Apr while FRAs price roughly 30bp of NBP hikes; the ECB and BoE are priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 57bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 250bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 15 Apr close). Truce-extension hopes; Brent ~$95 (15 Apr).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK offers FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0332 and FPC0235 on 16 Apr (min PLN 0.5bn); next tender 29 Apr; on 26 Mar it sold only PLN 0.87bn.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
